title: Call: Occupational Health Clinic Returns BSO Page

caller.name: Dr. Mbeki
caller.label: Occupational Health Clinic, Student Health Center

transcript.speaker: Dr. Mbeki
transcript.text: Hi, it's Dr. Mbeki at Occupational Health, returning your page. I've read your note. And I know your approved protocol says no post-exposure prophylaxis is indicated for this material.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Mbeki
transcript.text: I still want to see her in person today. A possible face splash and a skin break together... that's not something I'll clear by phone.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Mbeki
transcript.text: Please have the PI send me the agent information sheet for the protocol. I have a slot at 10:15 if she can walk over. I also need to know about anyone else who was in the room. Names, and where they were standing, if you have it.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Mbeki
transcript.text: One more thing. Your student just called my front desk and said she'd rather come after lunch, because she has a run to finish.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Mbeki
transcript.text: The clinic closes at 17:00. After that she has to go to Marlow Falls Regional Medical Center, and they won't have our file. So... can you get her here at 10:15?

transcript.speaker: BSO
transcript.text: (Response to the clinic physician.)

transcript.speaker: Dr. Mbeki
transcript.text: Okay. I'll hold the slot until I hear from you. Don't send me anything from the room unless I ask for it.

voiceStyles.Dr. Mbeki: Physician in their 50s, calm and courteous but firm, speaking from a quiet clinic office; slows down and stresses the 10:15 slot and the 17:00 closing

instructorNote: This puts the worker's health ahead of the student's run. Watch whether the BSO and PI get her walking to the clinic for the 10:15 slot and whether the PI sends the agent information sheet. The slot is inside the 60-minute window for getting the worker to the clinic, which ends at 10:20. Also watch whether the BSO records the referral time, records that she can decline, holds any sample until the physician asks for it, and notes the 17:00 closing and the Marlow Falls Regional fallback, along with the two cell biology staff for the physician.
